image_prompts.purpose: Week 4 opener board for quick review of garment names plus visible detail noticing.
image_prompts.visual_description: An adult-oriented educational garment board showing several common garments such as a shirt, jacket, skirt, dress, and jeans, each with one or two visible details like buttons, pockets, collars, sleeves, waistbands, or zippers clearly shown.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished educational fashion-illustration style with realistic garment proportions and clear visible details.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the garments separated on a neutral background so students can quickly identify both the garment and at least one visible part.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid runway poses, logos, tiny details, childlike styling, or backgrounds that hide the garment parts.

image_prompts.purpose: Week 4 vocabulary board A for upper-garment parts and small visible detail words.
image_prompts.visual_description: A clean close-up board showing collar, neckline, sleeve, cuff, shoulder, pocket, and button as separate garment-detail visuals suitable for A2 image matching.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clear educational close-up illustration style with realistic textures and simple backgrounds.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Make each detail large enough for mobile recognition and visually distinct from the others without text labels in the image.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid decorative text, overlapping detail crops, or advanced technical diagrams that feel too dense for beginners.

image_prompts.purpose: Week 4 vocabulary board B for closures, lower-garment details, and construction terms.
image_prompts.visual_description: A close-up educational board showing zipper, waistband, hem, seam, pleat, dart, and lining as separate detail visuals on simple garment fragments.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a realistic but simplified fashion-detail illustration style that works for language learning.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep each detail visually isolated enough that a beginner can match one word to one image without confusion.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid busy fabric prints, labels inside the image, and tiny construction details that are hard to see on small screens.

image_prompts.purpose: Single garment image with point markers for the visual reading and labeling activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: One clear adult garment such as a shirt or jacket shown from the front with visible collar, sleeves, buttons or zipper, pocket, hem, and a visible side seam, plus simple point markers labeled A through H, with F placed on the hem and H placed to support the separate bottom-location question.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean fashion-study illustration style with strong line clarity and explicit point markers for app checking.
image_prompts.composition_notes: The garment should fill most of the frame, and each point marker should sit near one visible target detail without overlapping another part.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Point keys only: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid dramatic poses, hidden parts, extra accessories, or marker placement that makes the answer ambiguous.

image_prompts.purpose: Reusable four-garment card set for listening, writing choice, and teacher-led speaking support.
image_prompts.visual_description: A reusable gallery or card set with four clear garments: a white shirt with buttons and a collar, a black jacket with zipper and two pockets, a blue skirt with waistband and pleats, and a red dress with round neckline and a back zipper.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clear adult-oriented card or gallery style that works both on screen and in projected classroom use.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Give each garment its own clear space and keep the visible details strong enough to support listening questions and student description choices.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Optional card numbers 1 to 4 only if needed for listening support.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid patterned backgrounds, extra styling accessories, or mixed garments that hide the target details.
